description: Preview importing an external plugin, changing no plugin of the project: the plugins its package offers (`candidates`; `picked` is null while one must be chosen with `pick`), what the picked one brings (skills, agents, MCP servers, rules), its licence and attribution, `warnings`, `ignored` parts and the proposed slug and name of a new plugin. With `plugin` also the merge preview into that plugin (`merge`), whose `previewId`, `sourceFingerprint` and `fingerprint` plugins_external_import takes as decisions. A preview expires after an hour. `source` is a public GitHub or GitLab repository URL (a tree URL picks a ref and a sub-folder), or the path of a local external plugin folder, resolved against the project root, which is zipped (without .git, node_modules and links) and uploaded. Formats: Agent Plugins (`plugin.json`), Claude Code plugins (`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`), marketplaces and `plugins/*` folders; skills, agents, MCP servers and the root `AGENTS.md` (as the rules) are imported, hooks, commands and the like are listed as ignored.

pick.description: The external plugin to import of a package that offers several (a marketplace or a plugins/ folder) (CLI: --pick).

plugin.description: Name of the plugin, or its id with pluginById (CLI: --plugin).

pluginById.description: `plugin` is a plugin id, not a name (CLI: --plugin-by-id).

source.description: Repository URL, or the path of a local external plugin folder.

name: plugins_external_import_preview
title: Preview external plugin import
